cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

set(PREMAKE_BUILD_TYPES "arm64-v8a-Debug" "armeabi-v7a-Debug" "x86-Debug" "x86_64-Debug" "arm64-v8a-Profile" "armeabi-v7a-Profile" "x86-Profile" "x86_64-Profile" "arm64-v8a-Release" "armeabi-v7a-Release" "x86-Release" "x86_64-Release")
get_property(multi_config GLOBAL PROPERTY GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
if(multi_config)
  set(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES "${PREMAKE_BUILD_TYPES}" CACHE STRING "list of supported configuration types" FORCE)
else()
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "arm64-v8a-Debug" CACHE STRING "Build Type of the project.")
  set_property(CACHE CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE PROPERTY STRINGS "${PREMAKE_BUILD_TYPES}")
  if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE IN_LIST PREMAKE_BUILD_TYPES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
      "Invalid build type '${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}'.
      CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE must be any one of the possible values:
      ${PREMAKE_BUILD_TYPES}"
    )
  endif()
endif()

set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_ARM64-V8A-DEBUG "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_ARM64-V8A-DEBUG "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_ARMEABI-V7A-DEBUG "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_ARMEABI-V7A-DEBUG "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_X86-DEBUG "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_X86-DEBUG "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_X86_64-DEBUG "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_X86_64-DEBUG "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_ARM64-V8A-PROFILE "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_ARM64-V8A-PROFILE "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_ARMEABI-V7A-PROFILE "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_ARMEABI-V7A-PROFILE "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_X86-PROFILE "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_X86-PROFILE "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_X86_64-PROFILE "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_X86_64-PROFILE "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_ARM64-V8A-RELEASE "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_ARM64-V8A-RELEASE "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_ARMEABI-V7A-RELEASE "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_ARMEABI-V7A-RELEASE "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_X86-RELEASE "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_X86-RELEASE "")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_X86_64-RELEASE "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_X86_64-RELEASE "")
